notablePrerequisites:
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your first extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
